name: idefix-telegram-public-corpus

content_md5.method: per table: md5(coalesce(string_agg(md5(ROW(<all columns in ordinal order>)::text), '' ORDER BY <primary key>), '')), PostgreSQL 17, session settings TimeZone=UTC, DateStyle=ISO, MDY, IntervalStyle=postgres, extra_float_digits=1, bytea_output=hex

sanitization: none -- complete snapshot: no row deleted, no table emptied, no column nulled, including comments (commenter ids, usernames and text) and every derived table

lossless restore verified: row count and content md5 of each of the 8 source tables equal the source restore before the upgrade (on the source columns; alembic_version excepted, it records the upgrade)
only additive migrations applied: alembic 0006 -> 0008 (new empty table(s) channel_llm_scores; new column(s) channel_scores.gate_families, NULL on every existing row)
owners and privileges stripped (pg_dump -Fc --no-owner --no-privileges); restore with pg_restore --no-owner --no-privileges
source hosting residue kept unchanged: row-level-security flag on 9 table(s), no policy; function(s) public.rls_auto_enable()
read-only secret scan: 4 collector secret value(s) from src.ingestor.session.secret_values() searched in every table and archived file -- 0 occurrence(s); data not modified
annotations archive: all 9 files under data/annotations/ and data/claims/ included byte-for-byte; nothing excluded or stripped
